questions.question: Using 2 468 and 1 795, show place value, comparison, odd or even, and rounding to the nearest 100 for each.
questions.expected_answer: 2 468 is 2 000 plus 400 plus 60 plus 8; 1 795 is 1 000 plus 700 plus 90 plus 5. Comparing thousands, 2 beats 1, so 2 468 is larger. 2 468 ends in 8 so it is even; 1 795 ends in 5 so it is odd. To the nearest 100, 2 468 is 2 500 and 1 795 is 1 800.

questions.question: Add 2 468 and 1 795, then subtract 1 795 from 2 468, showing one check for each.
questions.expected_answer: Addition in columns: 4 263; estimate 2 500 plus 1 800 is 4 300, close. Subtraction by compensating: 2 468 minus 1 800 is 668, add back 5 gives 673; check 1 795 plus 673 is 2 468.

questions.question: Work out 23 times 14 by the grid and 16 times 25 by doubling and halving, and list the factors of 24.
questions.expected_answer: Grid: 10 times 20 is 200, 10 times 3 is 30, 4 times 20 is 80, 4 times 3 is 12, total 322. Doubling and halving: 16 times 25 is 8 times 50 is 400. Factors of 24: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24.
